reason: Cline preparation blocked: Issue #868 '[每日信息流] 2024-12-26' is an AUTO-GENERATED daily content digest, not an engineering request. It carries only the 'daily' label, has zero comments, and its body is a Markdown checklist of ~150 external security-news/article links grouped by public account (安全脉搏, 先知安全技术社区, 奇安信攻防社区, Doonsec's feed, etc.). It is machine-created by this repository's own scheduled workflow: .github/workflows/daily.yml, step 'Issue' (line 40): `gh issue create --title "[每日信息流] `date +'%Y-%m-%d'`" -F today.md --label "daily"`. The most recent commit on main is literally '每日安全资讯(2026-10-30)' (SHA f1d886f585e807e82f84da6123f4858ef365f461), the same title pattern emitted by that step, and README.md section '信息流' documents '每日会在issue中生成昨日信息流'. The crawler (bot.py/yarb.py) writes today.md and the workflow files it as an issue. There is no defect, no failing behavior, no feature spec, no component reference, no reproduction step and no code-level request anywhere in the issue. The context's '$2,000' funding / technical_signals ['broken','bug','bug_bounty','issue','precision','protocols'] are keyword-derived noise harvested from the linked article titles (e.g. '漏洞挖掘', '获取$1600赏金的漏洞', 'bug bounty'), not a bounty attached to this issue; the issue page shows no funding and no open competitor PR targeting it. This is a content/documentation deliverable (a news feed), explicitly outside the scope of a concrete code change, so per policy the checkout is left unchanged and no fix branch, edit, or PR is created. No code-level engineering deliverable exists to implement or regress-test.
